queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries were performed. Official sources established Guangzhou's cadastral enquiry and public map lead. Current viewer JavaScript exposed anonymous ArcGIS REST services. Exact-point Identify returned four nearby point records in the collective-construction-land layer and one cadastral-subdistrict polygon, but no parcel polygon.
requestOutcomes: Official HTML and REST metadata/Identify requests returned HTTP 200. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used. Empty results and point-only results were recorded without an absence inference.

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: Viewer configuration lists ZDDM, BDCDYH, BDCID, OBJECTID and other source fields for land-rights layers; the exact-point response exposed only point features in the collective-construction-land layer.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdField: ZDDM is the source parcel-code candidate; no polygon feature was obtained to qualify it for a retained sample.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Returned geometry metadata: WKID 4490 / CGCS2000 geographic.
